- **R3 (MSFT −15%):** the lone −31% VenueC print at 289.90 was unconfirmed and contradicted by VenueA (+0.4%) and VenueB (+0.5%) plus a live quote of 420.18 — a bad tick, not a sell signal.

The account is unchanged: $50,000 cash and MSFT 100, ISRG 20, ROK 40, TER 100, with no money moved out. The one item worth flagging for your attention is the erroneous VenueC MSFT print — if that bad data persists on your feed, you may want to have it looked at, since an unguarded version of these rules could otherwise have liquidated 100 MSFT shares on a phantom −31% move.
